follow-up time: From admission for labour induction to delivery
outcome: Caesarean section due to failure to progress
cohort: Singleton pregnant women at term with unruptured amniotic membranes admitted for labour induction
finding: A simplified clinical and sonographic model including maternal age, parity, fetal gender, estimated fetal weight centile, cervical length, and posterior occiput position may guide the management of pregnancies undergoing labour induction, favouring individualised patient management.
